name: Custom Shape 1-Layer Mirror Acrylic Cake Topper
description:
KEY FEATURES

 

  • Premium Material:

- Crafted from premium 3mm thick mirror acrylic, delivering a sleek, reflective finish that adds elegance and sparkle to any cake.

- Available in two stunning color options — Silver Mirror and Gold Mirror — to complement any event theme or décor style.

- Durable acrylic construction ensures the topper maintains its shape and shine throughout the event without bending or fading.

- Lightweight yet sturdy material makes it easy to insert and remove from cakes without causing damage.

- The smooth, high-gloss mirror surface creates a luxurious visual effect that photographs beautifully under any lighting.

 

  • Sizes & Dimensions:

- Available in multiple sizes:

       +) 4 x 8 in ~ 10.16 x 20.32 cm | Min. thickness: 0.2 in / 0.5 cm

      +) 6 x 10 in ~ 15.24 x 25.4 cm | Min. thickness: 0.2 in / 0.5 cm

      +) 8 x 12 in ~ 20.32 x 30.48 cm | Min. thickness: 0.2 in / 0.5 cm

      +) 10 x 14 in ~ 25.4 x 36.56 cm | Min. thickness: 0.39 in / 1 cm

      +) 12 x 16 in ~ 30.48 x 40.64 cm | Min. thickness: 0.39 in / 1 cm

 

📌 Note: The product dimensions may vary slightly depending on the design, as sizes are not fixed.

 

  • Engraving Technology:

- Uses precision laser engraving (Engrave) and laser cutting (Cut Out) technology for sharp, intricate details on mirror acrylic surfaces.

- Capable of reproducing fine design elements such as monogram letters, floral motifs, dates, and custom text with exceptional accuracy.

- The laser process creates clean, smooth edges and crisp lines that enhance the overall premium look of the topper.

 

  • Functional & Usage:

- Features a slender stick base that inserts directly and securely into any cake layer without tools or adhesives.

- Single-layer design keeps the topper lightweight and proportionate for cakes of all sizes and tiers.

- Fully customizable with names, initials, dates, or personal messages to match your event theme.

- Easy to place and reposition, making it convenient for event planners, bakers, and DIY decorators.

- Suitable for weddings, birthdays, anniversaries, bridal showers, graduations, and all special celebrations.

 

  • Perfect Gift for Any Occasion:

- A truly personalized keepsake that goes beyond decoration — a memorable token guests and couples will cherish long after the event.

- Perfect for weddings, engagements, anniversaries, milestone birthdays, and intimate celebrations.

- Ideal for couples, event planners, cake designers, and anyone looking to add a custom, elegant touch to their special day.

- Makes a thoughtful and unique gift that reflects care, creativity, and personal meaning.

- Great for gifting as part of wedding favors, party packages, or celebration hampers.

- Adds a glamorous, sparkling, and unforgettable finishing touch to every celebration 🎁

 

SPECIFICATION

  • Processing Time: 1 – 3 working days on average after payment, and all designs are updated correctly
  • Shipping Time: 6 – 9 working days on average (US)
  • Packaging: 1x Custom Shape 1-Layer Mirror Acrylic Cake Topper

 

PRODUCTION

  • Manufacturer: Made by Printway
  • Tracking Country Origin is US

 

NOTE

  • Actual color may be slightly different from the image due to different monitor and light effects.
  • Please allow 0.2-0.3 cm differences due to manual measurement.
guideLine:
Print Guidelines

 

  • Below is our complete selection of art templates used for designing within the full printable area of our products. 
  • Each template comes with a .png detailing Safe Area, Bleed, etc. 
  • Download templates and mockups here

 

To use an Art Template:

 

  • Open the Printway template for your selected product in Photoshop or another design program.
  • Insert your artwork in a new layer, placing all important parts of your design within the designated “Safe zone” on the art template to ensure your design will not be cut off during the printing process.
  • If you’re designing drinkware, use the indicated centering lines to ensure your artwork is placed exactly where you’d like.
  • Hide or delete the Art Template layer from your file.
  • Save as a .png, .jpg, or another accepted file type.
  • You’ve now used a Printway template to create artwork exactly to the recommended specs for that product.

 

To ensure your design prints properly on each product:

 

  • Ensure all important elements of your design are within the safe zone on the product template.
  • Fill the entire design template! The outer edge of the template represents “Bleed Area,” which signifies the areas which may print on the outer edges of your product.
  • Failure to fill the bleed area will likely result in unprinted white unprinted areas around the edge of your product.
